sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>0 THEN MTM_AMT ELSE 0 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ce_ne_mtm FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT ORDER BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

SELECT ENTITY_TYP, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(CIF_REF) with_cif, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, MIN(CIF_REF) mn, MAX(CIF_REF) mx FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY GROUP BY ENTITY_TYP

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, COUNT(*) trades, SUM(e.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(e.NOTIONAL_AMT) notional,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY x WHERE x.CIF_REF = le.CIF_REF) cif_dups
FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE e LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID = e.ENTITY_ID
WHERE e.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF
HAVING SUM(e.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000
ORDER BY ce DESC

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(b.FACILITY_ID) with_sep_bal, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, MIN(f.PAYOFF_DT), MAX(f.CHGOFF_DT)
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CIF_NO, CLIENT_NM, SEGMENT_CD, CLIENT_STATUS FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE LTRIM(CIF_NO,'0') IN ('41850','42498','41539','41642','42036','42083','42648','41002','42233','42657','42037','42452','41974','41022','41168') OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Fund LP%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Capital Markets%' ORDER BY CIF_NO

SELECT f.CIF_NO, f.FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*) n_fac, LISTAGG(f.PRODUCT_CD, ',') prods, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, MAX(f.RISK_RATING) max_rr
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
WHERE f.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
